scope.budget: undiscounted_snapshot; not stale periodic decay budget

physical_pool_samples.semantics: allocator occupancy includes evictable and pending state; not unique useful KV

context_prefix_reuse_evidence.semantics: Previously served same-session input-prefix loss, not newly appended input or a per-layer FULL/Mamba recomputation count.

host_block_eviction_attribution.full_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix match plus request device/host cached-token intervals; remaining evicted FULL interval is attributed to recomputation
host_block_eviction_attribution.identity_semantics: run-keyed HMAC over exact cache namespace and radix token prefix; raw token IDs are not written
host_block_eviction_attribution.mamba_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix revisit is observable, but native telemetry does not expose the Mamba hit location per node
